reason: E1 directly supports the layered oxide formation and outward cation diffusion mechanism for CoCrFeNiMn alloys, but none of the cited evidence addresses the specific Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 composition, its additively manufactured state, or the link to catastrophic failure via pore formation.
premises: Oxidation of CoCrFeNiMn-based alloys forms a layered oxide with Cr-rich inner and Mn-rich outer oxides via outward cation diffusion.
This layered oxide formation mechanism applies to the specific additively manufactured Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 HEA.
The degradation is governed by species transport to the oxide/metal junction and passage through the oxide layer.
Catastrophic failure is linked to pore formation and accelerated oxide growth.
